units.source_text: 不久岁历更新。

en.t: Before long, the year turned anew.

units.source_text: 天空明丽，二条院内万事如意，百福骈臻。

en.t: The sky was bright and beautiful, and at the Nijo estate everything went auspiciously, with blessings arriving one upon another.

units.source_text: 各处殿宇，装饰得分外华丽。

en.t: All the halls and buildings were decorated with exceptional splendor.

units.source_text: 贺年客人络绎不绝。

en.t: New Year visitors came one after another without end.

units.source_text: 年辈较长的人，都在初七吃七菜粥的节日赶来庆祝。

en.t: The older people all hurried over to offer their greetings on the seventh day, the festival when seven-herb porridge is eaten.

units.source_text: 门前车马若市。

en.t: Before the gate, carriages and horses gathered as densely as in a marketplace.

units.source_text: 那些青年贵公子，个个无忧无虑，喜气洋洋。

en.t: Those young noble gentlemen were all carefree and radiant with joy.

units.source_text: 身份较次的人，心中虽有思虑，脸上怡然自得。

en.t: Even those of lower rank, though they had concerns in their hearts, wore expressions of easy contentment.

units.source_text: 看这光景，真可谓太平盛世。

en.t: Seeing such a scene, one could truly call it an age of peace and prosperity.

units.source_text: 住在东院西殿里的花散里，日子也过得很舒服。

en.t: Hanachirusato, who lived in the western hall of the eastern estate, also passed her days in great comfort.

units.source_text: 众侍女及女童等的服装，也照顾得很周到，生涯十分丰裕。

en.t: The clothing of her many ladies-in-waiting and young attendants was also carefully provided for, and their life was exceedingly well supplied.

units.source_text: 住在源氏公子近旁，自然便宜得多。

en.t: Living close to Prince Genji naturally brought many advantages.

units.source_text: 公子每逢闲暇无事之时，常常散步过来和她会面。

en.t: Whenever the prince had leisure and no duties, he would often stroll over to see her.

units.source_text: 至于特地来此宿夜，则甚难得。

en.t: As for his coming there expressly to spend the night, that was very rare.

units.source_text: 但花散里性情谦恭温顺，她认为自己命中注定，对公子的缘分止于如此，所以心满意足地悠闲度日。

en.t: But Hanachirusato was modest and gentle by nature; believing this to be her destined lot and that her bond with the prince went no further than this, she lived her days leisurely and content.

units.source_text: 因此源氏公子很放心，每逢四时佳节，对她待遇之丰厚，不亚于紫姬。

en.t: For that reason Prince Genji felt quite at ease, and at every seasonal festival his generous treatment of her was no less than that given to Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 上下诸人，都不敢看轻她。

en.t: People high and low all dared not look down on her.

units.source_text: 愿意伺候她的侍女也不少于紫姬。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting who wished to serve her were no fewer than those who served Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 家臣也都不敢怠慢于她。

en.t: The retainers, too, all dared not treat her with neglect.

units.source_text: 境况之佳，也无可指摘了。

en.t: As for the excellence of her circumstances, there was nothing at all to criticize.
